root_cause.text: The for loop condition in imx8m_blk_ctrl_remove() omitted the index comparison `i <`, causing an infinite loop that iterates beyond the bounds of the `bc->domains` array, leading to an out-of-range memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the loop from `for (i = 0; bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)` to `for (i = 0; i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)`, correcting the missing index bound check that previously caused the loop to run indefinitely and access memory outside the allocated array.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix infinite loop in imx8m_blk_ctrl_remove by adding proper index comparison in for loop condition.
intent_record.what: Changed loop condition from 'bc->onecell_data.num_domains' (which is always true) to 'i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains' to properly bound the loop iteration.
intent_record.how: Previously the loop ran indefinitely when num_domains was non-zero, causing out-of-bounds access. Now it iterates exactly num_domains times, correctly processing each domain.
